reviewer: The authoring assistant; not an independent human reviewer
criteria: One stable central object or problem
Clear cause, action, and consequence across the whole episode
Specific ending that follows the event
No excluded entities, copied slogans, finance claims, or runtime mechanisms

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Blue room square and availability notice
episodes.causal_review: A color fails to communicate rest; explicit wording establishes a usable boundary.
A stalled display creates concern; deliberate status wording replaces false live observation.
An optimization removes the end of a route; the narrator restores a clear stopping point.
An evening favor becomes indefinite access; expiration and a fresh limited invitation resolve it.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Read receipts and an unanswered message
episodes.causal_review: Delivery is confused with understanding; different contacts agree on meaningful signals.
Unbounded permission creates resentment; a direct request and temporary trials allow shared use.
Repeated searching defeats deletion; bounded access replaces the impossible goal of erasing history.
A preview loses a qualification; the narrator preserves provenance and makes a new practical agreement.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Scheduled promise to a future self
episodes.causal_review: A confident old prediction conflicts with actual progress; a question replaces the next grand promise.
Attention follows decoration instead of need; direct requests get a narrower signal.
Old quotations create endless summons; the sound is restricted to questions that need a response.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Empty inbox and a postponed reading task
episodes.causal_review: Absence of incoming work feels threatening; chosen slow work creates an independent purpose.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Full progress bar and unfinished result
episodes.causal_review: A premature completion display misleads a visitor; visible task state allows revision without false triumph.
The display advertises readiness the narrator cannot sustain; an explicit meaning replaces a claim of worth.
A symbolic new start fails to erase responsibility; a specific apology changes the ritual into a useful return.
A shortened claim spreads; preserving and correcting the record matters more than applause.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Retired plan pinned to a wall
episodes.causal_review: Old instructions outlive their purpose; a current question replaces repetitive completion rituals.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Mismatched clocks and a missed meeting
episodes.causal_review: A wrong time setting is mistaken for disrespect; shared references prevent a moral judgment about a technical difference.
A popular setting excludes one reader; trials distinguish preference from usable access.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Shared cursor and conflicting opening times
episodes.causal_review: Busy editing masks different assumptions; reading pauses establish one coherent notice.
A voting ritual consumes useful time; a reversible naming trial supplies practical evidence.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Closing digital room and a new address
episodes.causal_review: Exact copying fails to carry relationships; a tested move preserves the important continuity.

episodes.central_object_or_goal: Borrowed avatar with a new association
episodes.causal_review: A shared shape changes identity through use; clear naming allows the friend to keep it without confusion.
A private wish to stop affects patient visitors; handled questions and an explicit archive allow an honest departure.
